instruction.text: Find the coordinative conjunction in the text.

atoms.b: I went to a concert last night, ((so)) I am very tired today.
atoms.sound: I went to a concert last night, so I am very tired today.

atoms.b: We got to the venue early, ((so)) we didn’t have to wait.
atoms.sound: We got to the venue early, so we didn’t have to wait.

atoms.b: The music was very loud, ((so)) I have a headache today.
atoms.sound: The music was very loud, so I have a headache today.

atoms.b: I had a great time, ((so)) I’m going to buy more concert tickets!
atoms.sound: I had a great time, so I’m going to buy more concert tickets!

atoms.a: They wanted to get to the airport early,
atoms.sound: They wanted to get to the airport early, so they took an early train.

atoms.b: so she has fewer carbon dioxide emissions.
atoms.sound: She doesn’t drive to work, so she has fewer carbon dioxide emissions.

atoms.a: He took an umbrella to work,
atoms.b: so he did not get wet in the rain.
atoms.sound: He took an umbrella to work, so he did not get wet in the rain.

atoms.a: Millie worked hard all year for her exams,
atoms.sound: Millie worked hard all year for her exams, so she did very well.
